name: Sigma - LSASS Process Memory Access (T1003.001)
description: Detects suspicious access to LSASS process memory (Credential Dumping). Maps to MITRE T1003.001.

filter_expressions.expression: SELECT * FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCETYPENAME(devicetype) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND eventid IN (4656, 4663, 10) AND LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%lsass.exe%' AND (LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%0x1010%' OR LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%0x1410%' OR LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%0x147a%' OR LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%0x143a%') AND NOT (LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%msmpeng.exe%' OR LOWER(UTF8(payload)) LIKE '%defender%')

notes: Requires Sysmon Event ID 10. High confidence credential theft indicator.
